faqs.question: How often can I request a payout from Blue Guardian?
faqs.answer: Payouts can be requested bi-weekly (every 14 days) following your first executed trade on a funded account. Requests are generally processed within 24 to 48 hours.

seo.title: Blue Guardian Payout Frequency and Schedule
seo.metaDescription: Learn about Blue Guardian payout timelines, request intervals, and bi-weekly payout cycles.

faqs.question: What are the maximum and daily drawdown limits for Blue Guardian?
faqs.answer: Blue Guardian applies standard relative equity-based drawdowns: a 4% daily drawdown ceiling and an 8% maximum total drawdown limit across account sizes.

seo.title: Blue Guardian Drawdown Limits and Calculation
seo.metaDescription: Understand daily drawdown and maximum total drawdown limits on Blue Guardian accounts.

faqs.question: What is the default profit split and how does scaling work?
faqs.answer: Funded traders start with an 85% profit split. Consistently profitable traders meeting the 10% profit requirement over 3 months can scale their account balance up to $2,000,000 and receive a 90% profit split.

seo.title: Blue Guardian Profit Split and Scaling Plan
seo.metaDescription: Detailed breakdown of Blue Guardian profit split tiers starting at 85% up to 90%.

faqs.question: Are news trading and weekend position holding allowed?
faqs.answer: Yes, news trading and holding open trades over the weekend are permitted on most Blue Guardian account models, subject to normal slippage risks.
